items.headline: FMRB executive order classified-annex response clock
items.diff_narrative: Wednesday's fifth calendar day rolls to Thursday's sixth, with the deadline tightening from T-minus-one business day to T-minus-one business day still — but now against a Friday May 22 expiry sitting one calendar day out. Wednesday's three-of-eight witness count steps to five of eight as CISA Deputy Director and DARPA Director file substantive submissions during the Thursday morning window, joining Wednesday's ODNI, Tuesday's CISA Director, and Monday's NIST Director Locascio submissions, with three remaining witnesses confirming response drafts queued for the Friday filing window. Just Security observes the five-of-eight pace at the third-quarter mark of the response cadence is the steepest reading of the response curve to date. The House Energy and Commerce Subcommittee's parallel joint-resolution draft converts Wednesday's formal markup notice into a posted Thursday-morning calendar item locking the markup slot for the Wednesday May 27 morning session, with the staff-side amendment-in-the-nature-of-a-substitute now circulated as the first formal House-track committee text since the order's signing window opened.

items.headline: Cyber-evaluation reciprocity perimeter completes its sixteen-jurisdiction cohort
items.diff_narrative: Wednesday's sixteen-named-candidate count holds at sixteen on Thursday as OECD GENAI secretariat-reported member-state schema-comment submissions complete the cohort, reaching every named candidate plus the originating UK and EU as the business week's fourth day clears — eight calendar days ahead of the secretariat's Friday May 29 comment-close deadline. The plenary target steps from T-minus-thirteen to T-minus-twelve calendar days against the June 2-6 adoption window, with the secretariat now circulating the draft Recommendation text to member-state delegations for working-procedure review. Qatar's 270-day national-consultation window crosses its second-week midpoint, no third Gulf Cooperation Council member yet signals, and the United States recognition gap continues to hold open with the FMRB executive order — now at classified-annex day six — still the cited closure instrument expected to begin closing the gap once signed.

items.headline: n8n CVE-2026-21858 exposure clears federal-civilian remediation deadline
items.diff_narrative: The day-twenty Wednesday scan rolls to day-twenty-one Thursday — the federal-civilian remediation deadline day itself, no longer T-minus-one. Internet-exposed pre-1.121.0 instances fall from roughly 1,180 to roughly 980 — the first sub-1,000 reading since the catalog publication on day-zero — and the residual unpatched long-tail share eases from about 9 percent to about 7 percent. The US cohort eases from roughly 340 to roughly 290 and India from roughly 180 to roughly 150 as federal-civilian operators complete the bulk of their attestation submissions ahead of the 12:00 ET intake mark. Censys exploitation telemetry steps down from 1.7x baseline to approximately 1.5x baseline — the first sub-1.7x weekday read in the descent, consistent with commodity-tier volume settling into the post-deadline session. CISA confirms the federal-civilian remediation deadline closed successfully at the 12:00 ET intake mark with the eleven-CVE Trail of Bits compliance window keyed to Friday May 22 now at T-minus-one business day.

items.headline: MCP-server attack-surface telemetry crosses 93 percent for first time
items.diff_narrative: Wednesday's weekday cadence carries into Thursday's business-week fourth day with each consecutive-day counter ticking up one. The credential-extraction median holds at 5 minutes for a tenth consecutive day (from a ninth), with the unprotected-versus-protected gap tightening slightly from near 67x to near 66x as Defender-protected detection latency moves from 5.6 to 5.5 hours. Defender-for-Cloud quarantine on net-new MCP servers ticks from 50 percent to 52 percent — an eleventh consecutive day of expansion (from a tenth) and the second consecutive day above the half-of-net-new threshold. Cisco-Astrix identity-gateway tenancy edges from roughly 2,490 to roughly 2,525 enterprise tenants and Akamai SkyAtlas MCP-firewall from roughly 1,430 to roughly 1,450, with CrowdStrike Falcon for Agentic AI's managed-visibility composition nudging from 92 percent to 93 percent — a one-point uptick crossing the 93-percent line for the first time — and the total exposed-server estimate easing from roughly 8,870 to roughly 8,790.

items.headline: Loader-verification line converts to fully-cleared regulatory anchor
items.diff_narrative: Wednesday's fully-settled four-paper academic reference surface rolls to Thursday's fully-cleared regulatory anchor as the federal civilian directive cleanly clears its 12:00 ET remediation deadline and the May 22 compliance window steps to T-minus-one calendar day. The four-document academic reference set expands to five with the addition of Thursday's arxiv 2605.08019 applied-deployment companion sitting on top of Wednesday's 2605.07891 consolidation survey, converting the regulatory input from a forward-looking deadline into a settled precedent the framework cohort's mid-June default-shipment commitment can cite as cleared. The LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Haystack, and Pydantic AI maintainer cohort confirms the mid-June commitment with the five surfaces — load-time signed-checkpoint, manifest-allowlist with nested-dependency-resolution canonicalization extension, workflow-state path-canonicalization, intermediate-state-serializer canonicalization, and tenant-policy-attestation manifest as the optional sixth — unchanged, and now treats the mid-June ship as a downhill release rather than a question. The DeepMind/Meta AI/Anthropic/Microsoft consolidated index ships a single end-to-end conformance run covering all six verification surfaces.

items.headline: Alphabet analyst day lands disclosure-precedent inflection
items.diff_narrative: Wednesday's T-minus-one pre-print session converts on Thursday into the published analyst-day inflection itself. The Alphabet management script commits to a separately-broken-out AI Services revenue line in the Q2 2026 10-Q footnote tied to the SEC Corp Fin fourth sample comment letter language — breaking out the cloud-AI-services plus enterprise-AI-deployment plus per-seat agent registry components — resolving Wednesday's 90-percent breakout probability into a published commitment, with the cohort flagging that the precedent-conformance language matches the Friday sample comment letter substantively word-for-word on the three core disclosure pivots. The Bernstein-Wells Fargo-Evercore ISI-Citi Research-Jefferies-Goldman Sachs preview cohort upgrades the Mag-7 breakout-cohort probability from 90 percent to 96 percent — now reading Microsoft, Meta, and AWS fiscal Q3 2026 prints as effectively committed to the AI Services breakout — and pulls forward Microsoft's expected disclosure-precedent commentary from late-July into the back half of June. On the AI-accelerator IPO track, Tenstorrent's Corp Fin first-round response advances from a 13-business-day mark to a 14-business-day mark, with the second-round comment letter landing late-Thursday morning.

items.headline: Cerebras CBRS re-rates into upper half of analyst band on post-print read
items.diff_narrative: Wednesday's analyst-day eve session converts on Thursday into the post-analyst-day re-rating session — the canonical post-print inflection window the desk cohort had flagged. The five-desk analyst spread tightens upward: Bernstein's $185 Market-Perform floor still holds, Morgan Stanley's $192 target carries an upside-scenario probability stepping from 43 percent to 51 percent and crossing the half-probability threshold for the first time, Wells Fargo Securities Buy lifts from $208 to $215, Jefferies Outperform holds at $225, and UBS Neutral lifts from $205 to $212 — narrowing the analyst band into the upper half. Institutional-buyside cumulative net position edges from roughly 39 percent to roughly 42 percent of float as desks added incremental long exposure on the post-print tape, with the cohort flagging the cross-program allocation commentary in the Alphabet script as the canonical inflection input. The Saudi Aramco Digital MoU close advances from the back half of its late-Q2 2026 window into the final third, and the Saudi PIF contingent-secondary discussion moves from the back half into the closing stretch of the 10-21 day execution window.

items.headline: Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 reaches 72 gated tenants three days ahead
items.diff_narrative: Day thirteen rolls to day fourteen with the second-week growth normalization deepening — published skills rise from roughly 34,400 to roughly 35,900 (+4.4 percent, an eighth consecutive sub-7-percent reading and the second sub-5-percent day of the second week), skill installs from roughly 2.96M to roughly 3.04M, and auto-quarantined Mythos-class skills from 73 to 75. The gated-tenant cohort extends Wednesday's weekday cadence: two further enterprise customers join to lift the Mythos-Preview count from 70 to 72, with both new entrants in the North American financial-services tier as the cohort rotates back to North America after Wednesday's Continental European public-sector additions and Tuesday's Indo-Pacific additions. The verification harness's cross-tenant compositional safety check holds under 55 seconds across all 72 tenants and now executes Wednesday's five-document consolidation-survey end-to-end conformance run alongside the standard cross-tenant audit — confirming the demonstration cycle scales cleanly through the fifth surface. The Decoder notes the seventy-two-tenant mark was reached three business days ahead of the cohort's projected window (from two).

items.headline: Mistral AI Workflows reaches eleven central-government references
items.diff_narrative: Wednesday's tenth central-government reference (Denmark Skattestyrelsen) rolls to Thursday's eleventh — and the first eleven-reference reading the day-counter has carried — as Norway Skatteetaten joins as the first non-EU European entrant to the cohort, the fourth fresh central-government estate selection of the business week. Paid Workflows tenancy edges from roughly 415 to roughly 423 enterprise customers and daily executions from roughly 7.6M to roughly 7.7M. The six-vendor cross-orchestrator interop matrix (Codex CLI plus Claude Code 3.0 plus Mistral Workflows plus Azure AI Foundry plus Vertex AI Agent Governance Center plus Amazon Bedrock Agent Registry) holds its first-week-of-June general-availability target, with the conformance test suite now running Wednesday's five-document end-to-end conformance run as a third confirmation pass holding green across all six vendors for a fourth consecutive weekday.

items.headline: OpenAI per-org agent registry extends to twelfth Indo-Pacific region
items.diff_narrative: Wednesday's eleven-region Indo-Pacific GA footprint rolls to Thursday's twelfth region as Hong Kong joins (after Philippines on Wednesday, Thailand on Tuesday, and Malaysia on Monday), the fourth regional extension of the business week. GA-cohort tenancy edges from roughly 364 to roughly 371 enterprise customers, and OpenAI ships a Codex CLI v3.1.8 point release — three minor patches on top of Wednesday's v3.1.7 — adding optional client-side support for Wednesday's arxiv 2605.07891 consolidation-survey end-to-end conformance run as a paving step ahead of the early-June cross-orchestrator interop matrix GA target. The cohort reads the Hong Kong addition as continuing to track the sixteen-jurisdiction reciprocity perimeter rather than expand ahead of it, and flags that the only Indo-Pacific named-candidate still outside the GA footprint is Brunei following Wednesday's reciprocity-perimeter addition.

items.headline: Unsloth wires consolidation-survey end-to-end conformance run on every invocation
items.diff_narrative: Wednesday's roughly 0.4 percent peak combined VRAM tightening on the refined Mixture-of-Experts router-only LoRA path gets a further roughly 0.3 percent peak combined VRAM reduction on the DeepSeek R3-Pro 38B recipe on the same single-node octa-Hopper run, attributed to a layer-norm bucket-fusion micro-pass on top of Wednesday's router-attention bucket-fusion. Unsloth continues to carry the full five-surface agent-loader mitigation coverage plus the tenant-policy-attestation manifest as the optional sixth surface, and now executes Wednesday's arxiv 2605.07891 consolidation-survey end-to-end conformance run across all six surfaces as a fresh seventh validation pass on every training-driver invocation. The DeepSeek R3-Pro 38B recipe draws a twelfth Hacker News reproduction (from an eleventh), and a fourth contributor merges the OLMo-2 60B MoE port from a Wednesday pull request as a stable contributed recipe alongside the existing Qwen3 MoE 60B port.

items.headline: vLLM v0.11.4 stable converts into cleared regulatory-anchor reference
items.diff_narrative: Wednesday's second full operating day rolls to Thursday's third with no escalations from the maintainer cohort. The Yotta Labs throughput gap tightens further: from about 2.0 percent on Wednesday to about 1.8 percent on Thursday — about 19,260 tok/s on v0.11.4 stable versus about 19,600 tok/s on SGLang RadixArk v0.5.9, the tightest sustained band the benchmark has carried — with Cloudflare Infire holding L40S edge-tier parity at 1.00x into the fourth day post-stable. The v0.11.5 development branch now folds Wednesday's arxiv 2605.07891 consolidation-survey end-to-end conformance run in as the seventh verification step alongside the existing six-surface coverage, with Hugging Face TGI v3.2.2 plus SGLang RadixArk v0.5.9 also carrying the full set. The cohort treats Thursday's clean cross of the CISA federal-civilian remediation deadline as the regulatory-anchor settle-state day on which the v0.11.4 stable tag plus the now-cleared CISA directive plus the consolidation-survey paper can all be cited together as a single coherent stable-and-cleared reference.

items.headline: Tenstorrent Galaxy rack shipments reach 75 percent of capacity target
items.diff_narrative: Wednesday's weekday cadence carries into Thursday with a fresh batch lifting the cumulative count from roughly 198 to roughly 211 racks against the 280-rack first-half target — about 75 percent fulfilled (up from about 71 percent, a four-point uptick and the highest fulfillment reading the curve has carried). Additions span CoreWeave and Lambda Labs in North America plus a fourth Asia-Pacific increment splitting between Yotta Labs India and SK Cloud Korea plus a fourth European sovereign-cloud increment going to Open Telekom Cloud Germany and Aruba Cloud Italy on top of Wednesday's Outscale France plus Atlante Cloud Italy and Tuesday's UpCloud Finland plus Telefonica Tech Spain. AMD's Helios plus MI450 commitment book advances from near 10.7GW to near 10.95GW with a fresh weekday sovereign-cloud commitment — the fourth new commitment of the business week and the first time the book has cleared the 10.9GW mark — and the Tenstorrent confidential S-1 holds its early-August public-filing target.

items.headline: Cerebras CS-4 plus Vera Rubin plus AMD Helios book fresh Alphabet allocations
items.diff_narrative: Wednesday's hold-steady status converts on Thursday into a post-Alphabet-analyst-day allocation read with one fresh allocation surfacing on the post-print tape across each of the three accelerator tracks. Cerebras's four-batch schedule still places first-batch engineering samples to lead customer OpenAI in mid-Q1 2027, but a fresh Mythos-Preview-tier allocation has landed for Alphabet's enterprise-AI cloud-deployment program inside the third engineering-sample batch window — surfacing the cross-program allocation commentary the desk preview cohort had flagged. Nvidia's four shipped NVL576 engineering-sample batches hold their Wednesday allocations across the OpenAI, Meta, Anthropic, Apple, Mistral AI, xAI, and Microsoft Azure cohorts, with a fresh Thursday allocation to Alphabet ahead of the late-Q1 2027 production-volume window. AMD's first MI450 Helios production-rack samples to SoftBank Cloud Japan and SK Telecom Cloud Korea plus the NTT Data and Naver Cloud Indo-Pacific allied tier are extended on Thursday by a fresh allocation to Reliance Jio Cloud India.

items.headline: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 activates eleventh Fremont cohort, crosses 55 percent
items.diff_narrative: Wednesday's tenth cohort rolls to Thursday's eleventh: a fresh cohort of roughly twelve units comes online, lifting the active count from 120 to 132 of the disclosed 240-unit allocation — 55 percent reached (up from 50 percent) — with cycle-time still holding at the roughly 1.03x human-baseline envelope and the cumulative onboarding window now tracking three days ahead of the original projected curve. The eleventh cohort enters the Fremont automotive line on the same multi-station sealed parts-transfer chain that has been the standard cohort-onboarding workflow since the eighth-cohort activation, with cross-cell coordination on the tenth-cohort line continuing without incident through its second day of operation. The Stellantis Detroit (June 8) and Volkswagen Wolfsburg (June 22) activation dates hold, and Standard Bots pulls forward the expected completion of the disclosed 240-unit allocation from inside the first half of June to inside the first week of June if the weekday cadence holds.

items.headline: Boston Dynamics Atlas clears 168-hour milestone, runs toward 192-hour
items.diff_narrative: BMW Group's Spartanburg 30-unit Atlas pilot clears Wednesday's first North American 168-hour continuous-operation milestone — the longest continuous-operation milestone the BMW Spartanburg pilot has cleared — and now runs toward a first North American 192-hour milestone on the under-body conveyor task with zero MTBF-impacting incidents. Volkswagen Wolfsburg's Atlas pilot edges from roughly 91 to roughly 95 units on the body-shop welding-jig material-handoff task as the fourth weekday shift carries Monday through Wednesday's expansion pattern. The humanoid league-table OEM-adopter roster's flagged eighth adopter — Honda Lincoln — moves from due-diligence to a signed 20-unit pilot commitment, lifting the roster from seven to eight and giving the cohort its second consecutive day with a new OEM signing. Hyundai Metaplant's Dangjin rolling-mill cycle-time improvement holds near 5.2 percent for a tenth consecutive within-band day (from a ninth) with a small one-tenth-of-a-percent tightening on top of Wednesday's reading, and the policy-distillation pipeline now executes Thursday's consolidation-survey end-to-end conformance run on every policy-update cycle.

items.headline: Thursday arxiv 2605.08019 applied-deployment companion lands on deadline-clearing day
items.diff_narrative: A fresh Thursday arxiv release, 2605.08019, opens the business week's fourth research day by adding an applied-deployment-evaluation companion to the five-document loader-verification cluster that Wednesday's 2605.07891 consolidation survey had completed. Positioned as an applied study rather than a fresh formal model, it applies the 2605.07891 consolidation-survey reference set across a sample of Wednesday's federal-civilian remediation-deadline cohort and reports the end-to-end verification graph's runtime overhead inside production agent-loader workloads holding near the per-surface composition figure from the survey, with the deployment data confirming the marginal incremental overhead landing inside the survey's predicted bounds across an n-of-eleven operator sample. Simon Willison characterizes the paper as the first applied-deployment companion to the loader-verification line and observes that the timing — released the same business day as the CISA federal-civilian remediation deadline cleared — converts the academic reference set into a regulator-confirmed deployment record the framework cohort's mid-June default-shipment commitment can cite as a single coherent six-document end-to-end reference.
